name: kaleidohedra
description: Kaleidohedra, Rhombiverse and Polyhedraverse by DICTO, one app: build on crystal lattices (1D to 6D) and shear them, every piece moving with the lattice; 333 polyhedra and 4D polytopes up close; home of the Euclid–Kepler–Pacioli cell, the Sunstar Lattice, the DICTO Jewel, Hexa and Dodeca-13. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23173809

paragraphs: In development — live at kaleidohedra.vercel.app and rhombiverse.vercel.app. Since 2026-10-08 this repository is one app with two front doors: Kaleidohedra (orange), lattices you can shear and slide continuously, every piece moving with the lattice, and Rhombiverse (cyan), lattices of space-filling shapes from 1D to 6D. Each door has its own address, welcome, colours, guide and saved worlds; behind them the worlds, typography and controls are shared. The DICTO wizard (top left) opens on the app you came in by, with the others a button away; Polyhedraverse joins it next (KRP, DICTO's plan for…
